justification_span:
Age: 53, Weight: 59 kg, Height: 168 cm, Creatinine: 1.1 mg/dL

**BMI:**
Height = 1.68 m
BMI = 59 / (1.68²) = 59 / 2.8224 = 20.9 kg/m²

BMI is normal (18.5–25).

**Ideal Body Weight (male):**
Height in inches = 168 cm / 2.54 = 66.14 in
Inches over 60 = 6.14
IBW = 50 + 2.3 × 6.14 = 50 + 14.13 = 64.13 kg

**Adjusted Body Weight (normal BMI):**
Set to minimum of IBW and actual weight = min(64.13, 59) = 59 kg

**Cockcroft-Gault (male):**
CrCl = [(140 − age) × weight] / (72 × Scr)
= [(140 − 53) × 59] / (72 × 1.1)
= [87 × 59] / 79.2
= 5133 / 79.2
= 64.81 mL/min

FINAL: 64.81
